dbimaFilms.title: The Barren Field
dbimaFilms.institution: DBIMA — Don Bosco International Media Academy, Paris
dbimaFilms.tagline: A barren field is not the end of life—it is quiet waiting for a new seed.
dbimaFilms.synopsis: In a quiet village church in Tamil Nadu, Priya—five years into marriage without a child—is haunted by guilt over a past mistake and pushed to the brink of despair. Her encounter with Capuchin priest Fr. Prabhu (Br. Johnson of the Créteil fraternity) transforms confession into renewed hope.
dbimaFilms.directorNotes: Selected out of 15 student screenplays at DBIMA Paris for full-class production, marking the first-ever Tamil-language film directed at the academy. Generative AI served as the production office—bridging the language divide with AI storyboards, automated schedules, real-time on-set translation, French subtitles, and a Suno AI score.

dbimaFilms.title: DBIMA Halloween
dbimaFilms.tagline: From blank page to finalized cinematic render in 3 hours—at zero dollar budget.
dbimaFilms.synopsis: An experimental, end-to-end generative AI film created for the DBIMA Film Festival in Paris, integrating digital-twin likeness into artificially generated scenes with consistent cinematic lighting.
dbimaFilms.directorNotes: Completed in 3 hours total work, earning critical acclaim and prompting DBIMA to invite Fr. Joseph to teach AI creative-disruption techniques to Master's peers.

dbimaFilms.title: Jesus: an Anti-Virus
dbimaFilms.institution: DBIMA Paris • Solo Hybrid AI Studio
dbimaFilms.tagline: When the human network is corrupted, only a divine patch can restore the system.
dbimaFilms.synopsis: A technically ambitious narrative combining live-action 4K cinematography with fully functional interactive on-screen software ('Eden OS') built from scratch via Gemini Code.
dbimaFilms.directorNotes: Architected as a playable HTML operating system through 25 prompt-engineering iterations so actors could interact live on set, paired with Google Veo 3, Flow 3, RTX 3090 video-to-video VFX, and DaVinci Resolve Studio 20.
